description: This file contains utility functions for formatting and shortening tool metadata, including path shortening, meta string formatting, and grouping file paths for display purposes.

methods.name: shortenPath
methods.description: Shortens a file path by replacing the home directory with a shortcut.

methods.name: shortenMeta
methods.description: Shortens a metadata string, replacing the home directory path.

methods.name: formatToolAggregate
methods.description: Formats a summary of tool metadata, grouping paths and displaying emojis and labels.

methods.name: formatToolPrefix
methods.description: Creates a prefix string for a tool, including its name and meta information.

methods.name: formatMetaForDisplay
methods.description: Formats meta information for display, handling special cases for 'exec' and 'bash'.

methods.name: splitExecFlags
methods.description: Splits meta string into flags and body for execution commands.

methods.name: isPathLike
methods.description: Determines if a string resembles a file path.

methods.name: maybeWrapMarkdown
methods.description: Wraps a string in backticks if markdown formatting is enabled and no backticks are present.
